raw_value_text: 1939 Annual Report TNA CO 814/14  Athlit clearance camp for illegal immigrants was established in the end of last year. There was an annual course in prison administration under the auspices of the Home Office , Jail Labour co. No. 2 Athlit was also used as a place of detention for the greater part of the year. (p. 1), person detained under emergency regulation appear as non convicted, 9343 Arabs and 538 Jews were detained this year. religious denominations of convicted prisoners: 5153 Moslems, 602 Jews, 795 Christians, 94 others, 13.3% recidivists (p. 2), Remand Home which was established in Jerusalem last year was a solution for accomodation of juveniles awaiting trial. The building was also used for detention of juvenile offenders sentenced by military courts and "whose presence in the recognised Reformatory School was found to have a detrimental influence on the discipline of the school". these boys are accomodated in separate rooms from those awaiting trial, and are schooled. (p. 5) - prison population increased, but discipline declined by 25% "this is a satisfactory state of affairs, taking into considerationthat a large proportion of prisoners admitted to prison were convicted of offences of a political nature"
